description: This file defines a set of classes and templates related to feature management within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, including feature dependencies, setup, and flag processing mechanisms. It appears to be part of a larger system for configuring and managing features in a software project, likely related to Android or embedded systems.

classes.name: Feature
classes.description: A template base class representing a feature with a name and dependencies, including a static method for topological traversal.

classes.name: SetupFeature
classes.description: A class representing a setup feature, inheriting from Feature, with methods for running setup and checking if enabled.

classes.name: ReturningSetupFeature
classes.description: A template class extending SetupFeature, providing mechanisms to access calculated setup results.

classes.name: FlagFeature
classes.description: A class representing a feature related to flag processing, with methods for processing flags and generating help XML.

classes.name: GenericReturningSetupFeature
classes.description: A template class for setup features that perform calculations and store results, parameterized by a function and return type.

classes.name: GenericSetupImpl
classes.description: A template struct for creating components for setup functions, facilitating dependency injection.

methods.name: Feature::TopologicalVisit
methods.description: Performs a topological traversal of feature dependencies, applying a callback to each feature.

methods.name: SetupFeature::RunSetup
methods.description: Executes setup on a list of SetupFeature pointers.

methods.name: SetupFeature::Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the feature is enabled.

methods.name: ReturningSetupFeature::Move
methods.description: Moves the calculated result out of the feature.

methods.name: FlagFeature::ProcessFlags
methods.description: Processes a list of flags through the feature.

methods.name: FlagFeature::WriteGflagsHelpXml
methods.description: Generates XML help documentation for flags.

methods.name: Feature<Subclass>::TopologicalVisit
methods.description: Implementation of dependency traversal with cycle detection.

methods.name: SetupFeatureDeps
methods.description: Extracts dependencies from a tuple of arguments.

methods.name: GenericReturningSetupFeature::Calculate
methods.description: Performs the setup calculation, returning the result.

methods.name: GenericSetupImpl::Component
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component for a setup function.
